agent.problem: The first-person quotation is introduced only as "what is written," which does not identify who originally says "I." The card needs to identify the psalmist as the speaker.

rule.text: When he quotes someone speaking as "I," he says who it is first.

agent.problem: Quoting "I believed, therefore I have spoken" gives away "speak," the correct answer to the fill-in-the-blank question on card 10.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

agent.problem: The card cites only 2 Corinthians 4:17, but its statement that Paul was "STRUCK DOWN" also uses 2 Corinthians 4:9. Its citation therefore does not cover every passage fact it uses.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
